Make an impact

We’re super passionate about public transportation and the technology it takes to transform it.
We’re also a diverse and fun place to work – join us!
See all open positions
4.1

We make public transportation better. Together.

At Optibus, we are creating innovative products that have a positive impact on our world. From providing equitable access to all and nourishing sustainable cities to connecting people with their communities.

Our people make us who we are

The best thing about Optibus is our people. We are a team of tech enthusiasts and transit nerds, working together towards common goals. Work-life balance and flexibility are crucial to us, reflected in our company policies like flexible time-off and ‘Take a Breath days’.

We're committed to diversity, inclusion and equality

We focus on creating a diverse environment where different people can feel comfortable, included, equal, and wanted. Our product’s impact analysis tool ensures cities plan transportation with an eye to fairness and inclusion. We are actively working on closing the gender pay gap and support causes such as LGBTQIA+ rights.

What drives us

“At Optibus, I build teams driven to transform global transit. Our culture of flexibility and transparency fosters ownership, making every hire meaningful as we support millions of riders.”

Pedro Brandao, Talent Partner

"I'm excited about the Optibus EV module. Moving towards Zero Emission Buses is crucial for the environment, but scheduling and charging them can be challenging. The EV module is a powerful tool that tackles these challenges."

Perks
& benefits

Flexible time off 

We believe people should invest in their personal life, just like they invest in their professional life. That’s why we’ve instituted our “Flexible Time Off” policy – which eliminates the limit on the number of vacation days people can take per year.

Take a breath day 
Because we value our employees' wellbeing and their work-life balance, we introduced the concept of a "Take a Breath Weekend". This extended weekend occurs once a quarter and allows all of our employees to take a long weekend at the same time, with no work, no work-related correspondence, and no stress.
Volunteer opportunities

Making a positive impact on our communities and public transportation is at the core of our values. That's why we developed the Impact Program, which empowers our employees to engage in various volunteer opportunities

Training & development
Supporting individual development is important to us. ~60% of our managers were promoted for the role from an individual contributor role. We support your professional growth with a training budget, a mentoring program, formal career pathing, and much more.
Team events
We are proud of our great team! In order to facilitate social exchanges outside of work, we regularly organize team events on-site and online, from team night outs, to happy hours, to global events.
So much more!

There are also other benefits that depend on the region - feel free to ask us about them!

Perks
& benefits

Work from home allowance

We think that people should work where they can do it best. That's why we not only provide well-equipped offices in many locations, but also offer an individual budget to help facilitate a comfortable work from home environment for our employees

Stock options
We believe that you should own a part of what you’re creating. Employees are granted options to purchase Optibus shares. This way you can benefit from the success to which you contribute.
Parental support
At Optibus, we are dedicated to building an inclusive and supportive workplace and we recognize that families come in all shapes and sizes. We support parents before and after their parental leave, e.g. by enabling them to reduce work time while paying a full time salary.
Bike/scooter allowance
We stand for sustainable transportation - and want to enable our employees to commute in a sustainable way as well. That's why we support the purchase of a electric/regular bike/scooter.
Innovation
We promote a culture of innovation by embracing new technologies, investing in R&D and through continuous improvement. We hold annual Hackathons and Quickathons where you can build great products related to transportation or Optibus' internal operations. It’s your chance to share your ideas and make an impact!
So much more!

There are also other benefits that depend on the region - feel free to ask us about them!

We love having a good time

Proud to be recognized

Join the ride!

We welcome applications from everyone, even if you feel you don't meet all the requirements. Don't hesitate to apply and show us your unique skills! Research suggests that women specifically are less likely to apply for a job if they don't meet all the listed requirements, while men tend to take the leap! We believe in equal opportunities for everyone and fostering diversity in our organization.
